svg.title: Blueprint sheet 9, the plank: a try is not a change

g.text: A TRY IS NOT A CHANGE
draw lots of lines. the rule is for the cut.
draw as many as you like.
the old saying: measure twice, cut once.
it can fail. the muddle goes here.
made for real, in the world.
the rule is for this one:
a living blueprint for a world
